name: My Devil Sister
overview: Born into a powerful witch family, Lovett is cursed to lure men into deadly "tests of true love," where those who fail become sacrifices to sustain her family's magic. Longing to escape her fate, she believes she has finally found love with Elliot, only to watch him succumb to temptation. When she rescues the mysterious Charlie, a proud young heir hiding his own supernatural secret, Lovett discovers a love built on trust rather than deception. Together, they must break free from the curses of their families and fight for a future where they can finally live as ordinary people.
